images.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Create ONE square genuine transparent PNG character-expression comparison sheet with EXACTLY 4 waist-up busts of the SAME abstract character. Image 1 supplies CHARACTER STYLE only: bald opaque WHITE race-neutral gender-neutral figure, matching head shape, linework, clothing style; remove desk, pen, journal and other props. Images 2 onward supply EXPRESSIONS in order. Transfer eyes, eyebrows and mouth shapes accurately but NEVER copy their peach/brown backgrounds or skin tones or gendered eyelashes. Keep round spectacles if in face reference. Cute preschool proportions: big round head, thick rounded outline, small teal torso. Layout: four busts in an evenly spaced 2 by 2 grid, equal size, generous gaps and margins, relaxed neutral arms, large clear faces. Expression order reading left to right top to bottom: 1: worried: brows raised inward, side-looking eyes and tiny worried open mouth; 2: delighted: wide eyes and large open happy mouth; 3: one eye wide and the other squeezed shut, raised eyebrow and large vertical open surprised mouth; 4: round spectacles, side-glancing eyes and broad toothy grin. Each expression must match its corresponding input, preserve side glances, asymmetry, eyebrow angles, eye openness and mouth silhouettes. NO extra figures, no text, labels, numbers, words, symbols, frames or scenery. Transparent alpha everywhere outside characters, white heads and hands opaque. Flat SVG-like shapes, only 5–8 solid colors: ink #24243B, white #FFFFFF, teal #2CC6B0, blue #4C8DFF, lavender #A78BFA, coral #FF6B6B, yellow #FFD447. No shading, gradients, texture or 3D.
